dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure. I'll go take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: Great! I've done so much research on this place. Do you wanna know more?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's fine. I'll be able to handle it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about this treasure trove.

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: Follow this road and you will come across <color=#00E1FFFF>a tightly shut door</color>, behind that lies the legendary treasure trove! Apparently you only need to sacrifice the souls of <color=#00E1FFFF>100</color> cursed monsters to the watcher of the maze, and then you can just pop open the treasure trove door!

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: I'm not sure how it came to be, but the whole place is shrouded in a cursed fog. Even those with a Vision are only able to stay a short while before being forced out.

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: With that said, <color=#00E1FFFF>the chests here</color> are said to contain items that will help you to resist the fog's curse and <color=#00E1FFFF>increase your time in the maze</color>! Some of the chests being guarded by monsters can only be opened <color=#00E1FFFF>after the monster is defeated</color>. If you're going to give it a go, make sure to <color=#00E1FFFF>pay attention to the time</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: Legend has it that it's been occupied by a horde of monsters that are now unable to truly die because of the curse, making them stronger and stronger instead. What's more is that every time you pass through a passageway, the monsters and mechanisms in the nearby rooms randomly change.

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: Records seem to suggest that the color of the rooms somehow correlates to the monsters within. <color=#00E1FFFF>White rooms</color> generally only contain normal monsters while<color=#00E1FFFF>blue and orange rooms</color> feature elite monsters, and seem to have a connection with the watcher of the maze...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do I sacrifice cursed monster souls?

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: Killing a <color=#00E1FFFF>normal monster</color> sacrifices only one cursed soul. Killing a stronger <color=#00E1FFFF>elite monster</color> will sacrifice 4-6 souls. Keep this in mind when trying to reach 100 souls, especially given the time limit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who is the watcher of the maze?

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: It's said that when you reach <color=#00E1FFFF>75</color> sacrificed souls, the watcher of the maze will wake from a deep sleep and appear at a <color=#00E1FFFF>random place</color> somewhere in the maze. Killing it will get you a whole load of souls — enough to open the treasure trove. But it's a very powerful monster, so make sure you <color=#00E1FFFF>leave yourself enough time to battle it</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go give it a go.

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: Anything else you want to know?
